name: Boss Ai Agent
description:
AI management middleware for Claude Code/Cowork. 14 mentor philosophies shape
every decision — check-ins, chase reminders, summaries, project patrol, 1:1
prep, and emergency response. 9 culture packs adapt communication per
employee. Connects to Slack, Telegram, GitHub via MCP. Works fully offline.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, **3 agents**, **9 commands**, **1 hook** and **2 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (1): `boss-ai-agent` (Use when the user discusses team management, employee check-ins, daily standups, project health, 1:1 meetings, team sentiment, management…)
- **Agents** (3): `github-scanner` (Scans GitHub repos for stale PRs, failed CI, and stale issues), `sentiment-analyzer` (Analyzes employee report text and produces sentiment scores), `signal-scanner` (Analyzes team messages for critical, warning, and positive signals)
- **Commands** (9): `1on1` (Prepare a 1:1 meeting brief for a specific team member), `briefing` (Generate a smart morning briefing with prioritized action items), `chase` (Chase team members who haven't submitted their daily report), `checkin` (Send daily check-in questions to all active team members), `mentor` (Switch mentor philosophy or view current mentor), `patrol` (Run project health patrol — scan GitHub, Slack, and other tools for issues), `setup` (First-run setup for Boss AI Agent — configure team, channels, and mentor), `summary` (Generate a daily or weekly management summary), and 1 more
- **Hooks** (1): `SessionStart`
- **MCP servers** (2): `slack`, `github`

Installs with `claude plugin install boss-ai-agent@claude-community` from `tonypk/boss-ai-agent-claude-plugin`.
